abstract: This paper presents an economic analysis of US agricultural policy, building on a modified version of Gardner's efficient redistribution. We argue that agricultural policy is motivated as an attempt to implement an efficient redistribution scheme that redistributes income toward farmers who, as a group, have been adversely affected by agricultural productivity growth. We show how this approach helps explain why subsidies are more common in agriculture than in other sectors of the economy. We explore how our analysis provides new and useful insights into the design and implementation of US agricultural policy.
abstract_zh: 本文基于加德纳有效再分配理论的修正版本，对美国农业政策进行了经济分析。我们认为，农业政策的动机在于试图实施一种有效的再分配方案，将收入重新分配给那些因农业生产率增长而受到不利影响的农民群体。我们展示了这一方法如何有助于解释为何补贴在农业领域比在经济其他部门更为普遍。我们探讨了我们的分析如何为美国农业政策的设计与实施提供新颖且有益的见解。
title: On the Economics of US Agricultural Policy
title_zh: 美国农业政策经济学研究

abstract: Using information in returns, we identify the stochastic process of consumption. We find that aggregate consumption reacts over multiple quarters to innovations spanned by financial markets. This persistent component accounts for over a quarter of consumption variation. These shocks command a large and significant risk premium, driving a large share of stocks' and a small yet significant fraction of bonds' time‐series variation. Nevertheless, we find no support for stochastic volatility of consumption driving time‐varying risk premia. Finally, an otherwise standard recursive utility model based on our estimated process explains equity premium and risk‐free rate puzzles with low‐risk aversion.
abstract_zh: 利用收益率中的信息，我们识别了消费的随机过程。研究发现，总体消费对金融市场所涵盖的冲击会持续多个季度作出反应。这一持久性成分解释了超过四分之一的消费波动。这些冲击具有显著且规模较大的风险溢价，驱动了股票时间序列变化的主要部分以及债券时间序列变化中虽小但显著的部分。然而，我们并未发现消费的随机波动性驱动时变风险溢价的证据。最后，基于我们估计过程的递归效用模型（在其他方面均为标准设定）在低风险厌恶水平下解释了股权溢价和无风险利率之谜。
title: Consumption in Asset Returns
title_zh: 资产收益中的消费

abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
abstract_zh: 利用涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和未受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的颗粒化数据，我们提供了关于散户投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。首先，我们证明散户投资者在股票交易中尽管面临高昂的借贷成本仍选择加杠杆的行为，与其博彩偏好相关。其次，我们揭示保证金借贷会影响投资者的交易行为——当投资者接近追加保证金通知时，更倾向于抛售持仓。最后，我们证明由保证金驱动的交易会聚合影响资产价格，并加剧股票间的冲击溢出效应（例如，从博彩类股票向非博彩类股票传导）。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
title_zh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响

abstract: In an instrumental variable framework, we define supercompliers as the subpopulation whose treatment take-up positively responds to eligibility and whose outcome positively responds to take-up. Supercompliers are the only subpopulation to benefit from treatment eligibility and, hence, are important for policy evaluation. We propose conditions for characterizing supercompliers, and show how estimation and inference can be conducted with instrumental variable regression. In two job training experiments, we demonstrate our machinery’s utility, particularly in incorporating social welfare weights into marginal value of public funds analyses.
abstract_zh: 在工具变量框架下，我们将“超级依从者”定义为治疗接受度对资格条件呈正向响应、且结果对治疗接受度呈正向响应的子群体。超级依从者是唯一从治疗资格中获益的子群体，因此对政策评估具有重要意义。我们提出了刻画超级依从者的条件，并展示了如何利用工具变量回归进行估计与推断。在两个职业培训实验中，我们展示了该方法的实用性，特别是在将社会福利权重纳入公共资金边际价值分析中的应用。
title: Supercompliers
title_zh: 超级合规者

journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: Operational Proximity and Cross-Border Shareholder Monitoring
title_zh: 运营邻近性与跨境股东监督

abstract: Contract theorists routinely assume that opportunities for efficient breach are exogeneous. This prompts the conventional approach to contract remedies, according to which expectation damages are preferred to the disgorgement rule: when ex-post renegotiations are unfeasible, the former regime facilitates efficient breach while the latter deters it. In this paper, I offer a simple model in which two parties to a contract can exert search efforts to locate better contractual alternatives. The endogeneity of efficient-breach opportunities gives rise to a novel outlook on the choice of remedies for a breach of contract. Specifically, this paper opts out of the expectation damages versus disgorgement distinction to offer two new remedies: conditional disgorgement, which ignores each party's breaching or non-breaching status and grants the breach surplus to the party who has located a better contractual alternative; and partial disgorgement, which divides the breach surplus by bestowing a fixed, predetermined share upon each party. I show that these remedies are generally superior to extant regimes in terms of inducing optimal search efforts. The underlying intuition is that under the proposed rules, each party is better off with being either the breaching or the non-breaching party, and therefore, is incentivized to carry out both selfish and cooperative search. This paper likewise makes the inner comparison between conditional and partial disgorgement, deriving conditions for the optimality of each rule. Finally, it discusses the results in light of existing contract doctrine and commercial practice.
abstract_zh: 合同理论家通常假设有效违约的机会是外生的。这促使了合同救济的传统方法，即预期损害赔偿优于返还规则：当事后重新谈判不可行时，前者促进有效违约，而后者则阻碍之。本文提出一个简单模型，其中合同双方可以付出搜寻努力以寻找更好的合同替代方案。有效违约机会的内生性为违约救济的选择提供了新的视角。具体而言，本文超越了预期损害赔偿与返还规则的传统区分，提出了两种新的救济方式：条件性返还，它忽略各方的违约或非违约状态，将违约盈余授予找到更好合同替代方案的一方；以及部分返还，通过向各方分配固定的预定份额来分割违约盈余。我证明，在诱导最优搜寻努力方面，这些救济方式通常优于现有制度。其基本直觉是，在提议的规则下，无论是作为违约方还是非违约方，各方都能获益，因此有动力进行既利己又合作的搜寻。本文同样对条件性返还与部分返还进行了内部比较，推导出每种规则最优性的条件。最后，结合现有合同理论与商业实践对结果进行了讨论。
title: Contract Remedies and Search Efforts
title_zh: 合同救济与搜寻努力

abstract: The Dodd-Frank Act in 2010 increased ex ante downgrade threats without changing credit-rated firms’ underlying credit quality. We show that the act had negative impacts on credit-rated firms’ acquisition activities, especially among speculative-grade firms as they face greater downgrade-induced costs. The more selective acquisition strategies led to higher announcement returns and greater postacquisition upgrade probabilities. Consistent with firms refraining from taking on overall acquisition risk rather than financial risk, we show significant reductions in both cash-and stock-settled dealmaking after the Dodd-Frank Act. In sum, our study highlights that increased legal stringency on credit rating agencies has important spillover effects on firms’ mergers and acquisitions activities.
abstract_zh: 2010年的《多德-弗兰克法案》在不改变信用评级公司基础信用质量的情况下，增加了事前降级威胁。我们证明该法案对信用评级公司的收购活动产生了负面影响，尤其是在投机级公司中，因为它们面临更大的降级引发的成本。更为审慎的收购策略导致了更高的公告回报和更大的收购后升级概率。与公司避免承担整体收购风险而非财务风险的行为一致，我们发现在《多德-弗兰克法案》之后，现金结算和股票结算的交易活动均显著减少。总之，我们的研究强调，对信用评级机构加强法律约束对企业的并购活动具有重要的溢出效应。
title: The Impact of the Dodd-Frank Act on Acquisition Activity
title_zh: 多德-弗兰克法案对收购活动的影响

abstract: Migrant domestic workers (MDWs) are highly vulnerable to labor abuse. Usinga survey and randomized controlled trial conducted in Hong Kong, this studyinvestigates MDWs’ labor experiences and the potential of rights awarenesscampaigns to mitigate labor abuse. The campaigns increased public knowledgeof MDWs’ rights and reduced the social acceptability of MDWs’ mistreatment.To the extent that improving knowledge about MDWs’ rights and decreasingacceptance of mistreatment affect the behaviors of employers and others whocan support MDWs, rights awareness campaigns can help reduce labor abuse.However, the campaigns had limited impact on MDWs, who demonstrated highawareness of their rights but often experienced concerning levels of abuse andregarded mistreatment as an unavoidable aspect of their employment. These differences highlight the constrained agency of MDWs to independently improvetheir labor conditions and emphasize the value of rights awareness initiativestargeting employers of MDWs and the general public.
abstract_zh: 外籍家庭佣工（MDWs）在劳动权益方面高度脆弱。本研究基于在香港开展的问卷调查与随机对照试验，考察了外籍家庭佣工的劳动经历，以及权利意识宣传活动在减少劳动虐待方面的潜力。这些宣传活动提升了公众对外籍家庭佣工权利的认知，并降低了社会对虐待外籍家庭佣工行为的接受度。在改善外籍家庭佣工权利认知与降低虐待行为接受度能够影响雇主及其他支持者行为的前提下，权利意识宣传活动有助于减少劳动虐待。然而，此类活动对外籍家庭佣工自身的影响有限——他们虽对自身权利有较高认知，却常遭遇令人担忧的虐待程度，并将虐待视为其就业中不可避免的组成部分。这些差异凸显了外籍家庭佣工在独立改善劳动条件方面受到的能力限制，并强调了针对外籍家庭佣工雇主及普通公众开展权利意识倡议的价值。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Growing Awareness to Reduce Labor Abuse: An Experimental Test of a Migrant Domestic Workers’ Rights Awareness Campaign
title_zh: 减少劳工虐待意识的提升：一项针对移民家政工人权利意识运动的实验检验

abstract: Proponents of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) argue that expanding legal access to marijuana may serve an important social justice objective by reducing racial disparities in arrest rates. Using data from the Uniform Crime Reports and a generalized difference-in-differences approach, we find support for this claim: RML adoption is associated with a reduction of 498–561 marijuana arrests per 100,000 persons (over 90 percent) among Black adults and a reduction of 128–145 arrests (78–88 percent) among White adults. However, we find no evidence that RML adoption reduces racial disparities in nonmarijuana drug arrests or arrests for property and violent crimes, and post-RML reallocation of policing resources to fight nonmarijuana drug crime and violent crime may, in some circumstances, widen these racial disparities. Finally, RMLs reduce opioid-related mortality among non-Hispanic Whites relative to Blacks and Hispanics, consistent with the hypothesis that those hardest hit at the outset of the US opioid epidemic disproportionately gain from recreational marijuana legalization.
abstract_zh: 娱乐性大麻合法化（RML）的支持者认为，扩大大麻合法获取渠道可通过减少逮捕率中的种族差异，实现重要的社会公正目标。基于《统一犯罪报告》数据并采用广义双重差分法，我们验证了这一主张：RML实施后，黑人成年人每10万人中大麻相关逮捕人数减少498-561人（降幅超90%），白人成年人减少128-145人（降幅78%-88%）。然而，未发现RML实施能缩小非大麻类毒品逮捕、财产犯罪及暴力犯罪逮捕中的种族差异；在特定情境下，RML实施后警务资源向非大麻毒品犯罪与暴力犯罪的重新配置，反而可能加剧这些领域的种族差异。此外，相较于黑人与西班牙裔群体，RML显著降低了非西班牙裔白人的阿片类药物相关死亡率，这与"美国阿片类药物危机初期受影响最严重群体从娱乐性大麻合法化中获益更多"的假说一致。
title: Recreational Marijuana Laws and Racial Disparities: New Evidence on Arrests and Deaths of Despair
title_zh: 娱乐性大麻法案与种族差异：逮捕与绝望死亡的新证据

abstract: Insufficient trust in journalists creates space for disinformation. We ask whether institutions can safeguard trust in journalists. Our main finding is that the rule of law is positively and robustly associated with trust in journalists. The rule of law arguably promotes trustworthy behavior by punishing deceit and dishonesty, thereby fostering trust. Robustness checks support this result. Moderation analysis indicates that the relationship between the rule of law and trust in journalists is weaker in low-income countries; this difference vanishes once gross domestic product per capita, a variable strongly correlated with the rule of lawyer negatively associated with trust in journalists, is taken into account. A heterogeneous treatment analysis using the COVID-19 pandemic as an exogenous shock to trust levels offers suggestive evidence against reverse causality. Though exploratory, our findings point to the importance of high-quality legal institutions in combatting distrust in journalists.
abstract_zh: 对记者的信任不足为虚假信息提供了空间。我们探究制度能否维护对记者的信任。主要发现是，法治水平与对记者的信任呈稳健的正相关关系。法治通过惩罚欺骗与不诚实行为，促进可信赖行为，从而培育信任。稳健性检验支持这一结果。调节效应分析表明，在低收入国家，法治与记者信任之间的关联较弱；一旦考虑人均国内生产总值（这一与法治高度相关且与记者信任呈负相关的变量），该差异便消失。利用新冠疫情作为信任水平的外生冲击进行的异质性处理分析，提供了反向因果关系的提示性证据。尽管本研究属于探索性分析，但研究结果凸显了高质量法律制度在对抗对记者不信任中的重要性。
title: The Rule of Law Predicts Trust in Journalists
title_zh: 法治预测对记者的信任

abstract: Has automakers’ use of artificial intelligence (AI) in advanced driver-assistance systems (ADASs) improved automobile safety? We address this question with a first-of-its-kind trim-level dataset of the universe of registered automobiles and accidents in Texas over a 9-year period. We find that ADASs reduce the risk of a motorist getting in any type of accident by 11 to 14 percent and reduce the risk of a motorist getting in a single-vehicle fatal accident by roughly one-third. Our finding that ADASs have improved automobile safety is especially important because it provides early evidence of the benefits of vehicle automation in actual travel environments. Hopefully, it will spur greater interest in the development and widespread adoption of fully autonomous vehicles and in the potential benefits of other transportation technologies using AI.
abstract_zh: 汽车制造商在高级驾驶辅助系统（ADASs）中应用人工智能（AI）是否提升了汽车安全性？我们利用覆盖得克萨斯州9年间所有注册车辆及事故的首个车型级别数据集，对此问题展开研究。研究发现，ADASs使驾驶员发生任何类型事故的风险降低11%至14%，并将单车致命事故的风险降低约三分之一。这一结论尤为重要，因为它首次提供了车辆自动化在实际出行环境中带来益处的早期证据。我们期待该发现能激发对全自动驾驶汽车研发与普及的更大兴趣，并推动对运用AI的其他交通技术潜在效益的深入探索。
title: AI at the Wheel: The Effectiveness of Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems
title_zh: AI驾驶：高级驾驶辅助系统的有效性

abstract: We examine whether the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934 significantly stabilized the market by introducing mandatory disclosure of information. We argue that mandatory information disclosure can curb stock manipulation by enhancing transparency, thereby reducing excess stock volatility. After a comprehensive assessment of the voluntary disclosure practices of companies listed on the New York Stock Exchange before 1934, we find that those with poor disclosure practices experienced a significantly greater reduction in volatility after the implementation of the act compared with those with good disclosure practices. Further analysis reveals that the liquidity of these companies with poor disclosure practices also improved significantly more than that of companies with better disclosure, and the improvement in liquidity was linked to the decrease in their volatility. Given that one key purpose of the act’s legislators was to reduce excess market volatility, our findings provide empirical support for considering this legislative aim successful.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1934年美国《证券交易法》是否通过引入强制性信息披露显著稳定了市场。我们认为，强制性信息披露能够通过提升透明度抑制股票操纵行为，从而降低股票过度波动。在对1934年前纽约证券交易所上市公司自愿披露实践进行全面评估后，我们发现：相较于披露实践良好的公司，披露实践较差的公司在该法案实施后波动性下降幅度显著更大。进一步分析表明，这些披露实践较差公司的流动性改善程度也显著优于披露较好的公司，且流动性改善与其波动性下降存在关联。鉴于该法案立法者的核心目标之一是减少市场过度波动，我们的研究结果为认定该立法目标已成功实现提供了实证支持。
title: Does Securities Regulation Matter? Mandatory Disclosure, Excess Stock Volatility, and the US Securities Exchange Act of 1934
title_zh: 证券监管重要吗？强制披露、股票过度波动与1934年美国证券交易法

abstract: Housework is central to feminist calls for recognition of women's work, economic histories explaining the sexual division of labour, and claims regarding the progressive role of scientific knowledge. Yet little is known about the time it actually took. We address this lacuna. We utilize British sources and find a substantial increase in the hours ordinary women spent on domestic labour between the late‐eighteenth and the mid‐twentieth centuries. We note the changing imperatives of state involvement and industrial development and explore how the additional domestic labour served the interests of state and employers as well as those of husbands and children.
abstract_zh: 家务劳动是女性主义呼吁承认女性工作、经济史解释性别劳动分工以及主张科学知识进步作用的核心议题。然而，关于家务劳动实际耗费的时间，我们知之甚少。本文旨在填补这一空白。我们利用英国史料发现，从18世纪末到20世纪中期，普通女性从事家务劳动的时间大幅增加。我们注意到国家干预与工业发展的不断变化的必要性，并探讨了额外家务劳动如何服务于国家、雇主以及丈夫和子女的利益。
title: ‘Elbow grease and yellow soap’: Housework time in working‐class households in late‐nineteenth and early twentieth‐century Britain
title_zh: 《“苦干与黄皂”：19世纪末20世纪初英国工人阶级家庭的家务劳动时间》

abstract: This paper examines how the Kansas tax experiment, which eliminated state income taxes on pass-through entities between 2012 and 2017, affected firms’ debt payment behavior, a key indicator of liquidity constraint. Using establishment-level data from the National Establishment Time Series (NETS) and exploiting the geographic discontinuity in the Kansas City metropolitan area, we estimate the causal effect of the reform using a spatially anchored difference-in-differences framework. The results show that eliminating pass-through income led to a measurable, but temporary, improvement in the timeliness of debt payments. The average duration of delayed payments was reduced by one-third in the baseline model. The effects were heterogeneous and significant in small and non-publicly listed establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2012年至2017年间堪萨斯州税收实验（该实验取消了穿透实体州所得税）对企业债务支付行为（流动性约束的关键指标）的影响。利用国家企业时间序列数据库（NETS）中的企业层面数据，并借助堪萨斯城都市区的地理断点特征，我们采用空间锚定双重差分框架估计了该改革的因果效应。结果表明，取消穿透实体所得税显著但暂时地改善了债务支付的及时性。在基准模型中，延迟支付的平均时长减少了三分之一。该效应在小型及非上市企业中呈现异质性且更为显著。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Do tax cuts ease liquidity constraints?
title_zh: 减税是否缓解了流动性约束？

abstract: We study an agency model with two independent projects each of which is owned by a principal. Under exclusive agency, each principal uses a different agent, whereas under common agency, all principals use the same agent. A project’s outcome depends on the agent’s hidden effort. We show that, even in the absence of physical linkages between the projects, a principal benefits from providing information on her project outcome to the other principal under common agency (rather than benefiting from receiving the information ), whereas no such benefits arise under exclusive agency. That is, under common agency, an information sharing principal can take advantage of the other principal’s using the shared information. As a result, sharing information becomes each principal’s dominant strategy, provided that the other principal uses the shared information in a Pareto-optimal way. We show that using a common agent is optimal when information can be shared.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个包含两个独立项目的委托代理模型，每个项目由一位委托人所有。在独家代理模式下，每位委托人雇佣不同的代理人；而在共同代理模式下，所有委托人雇佣同一代理人。项目的产出取决于代理人的隐性努力。研究表明，即使项目之间不存在物理关联，在共同代理模式下，委托人通过向另一位委托人提供自身项目结果的信息（而非接收信息）能够获益，而这种收益在独家代理模式下并不存在。也就是说，在共同代理模式下，共享信息的委托人可以利用另一位委托人对共享信息的使用。因此，只要另一位委托人以帕累托最优方式使用共享信息，信息共享将成为每位委托人的占优策略。我们证明，当信息可以共享时，使用共同代理人是最优选择。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Information alliance in common agency
title_zh: 共同代理中的信息联盟

abstract: This paper examines the evolution of strategies in repeated 2 x 2 anti-coordination games. Turn-taking is advantageous against strategies that consistently choose the same stage-game action, provided the discount factor is sufficiently high or the payoff asymmetry in coordination is sufficiently low. However, it becomes vulnerable when the set of strategies allowed to invade is expanded. Nonetheless, if the matching process exhibits a high degree of assortativity, turn-taking regains robustness as long as it promotes efficiency.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演变。当贴现因子足够高或协调中的收益不对称性足够低时，轮流选择策略相对于持续选择相同阶段博弈行动的策略具有优势。然而，当允许入侵的策略集合扩大时，这种优势变得脆弱。尽管如此，如果匹配过程表现出高度的同类相配性，只要轮流选择能促进效率，它便能重新获得稳健性。
title: The evolution of strategies in repeated 2  ×  2 anti-coordination games
title_zh: 重复2×2反协调博弈中策略的演化

abstract: We study how rising longevity affects the long-run real interest rate in an overlapping-generations model with mortality risk and accidental bequests to the young. Longer lives increase retirement saving, which tends to lower the interest rate, but they also reduce such bequests and shift asset payoffs from young savers to surviving retirees, weakening aggregate saving. Public debt amplifies this second force. When debt is sufficiently high, further increases in longevity eventually raise the steady-state interest rate. Thus, longevity need not continue to depress interest rates: with large public debt, the relationship between longevity and the interest rate becomes non-monotonic. • We study the longevity–interest rate relationship in an OLG model with accidental bequests. • Longevity raises saving but reduces accidental bequests to the young. • Public debt amplifies the decline in bequests and shifts asset payoffs. • High public debt can make the relationship U-shaped.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在包含死亡风险和向年轻人意外遗赠的交叠世代模型中，寿命延长如何影响长期实际利率。更长的寿命增加了退休储蓄，这倾向于降低利率，但同时也减少了此类遗赠，并将资产收益从年轻储蓄者转移至存活的退休者，从而削弱了总体储蓄。公共债务放大了这第二种力量。当债务足够高时，寿命的进一步延长最终会提高稳态利率。因此，寿命延长未必持续压低利率：在公共债务庞大的情况下，寿命与利率之间的关系变为非单调的。• 我们在包含意外遗赠的OLG模型中研究了寿命与利率的关系。• 寿命延长提高了储蓄，但减少了对年轻人的意外遗赠。• 公共债务加剧了遗赠的减少并转移了资产收益。• 高公共债务可使该关系呈U形。
title: Fiscal demographic reversal
title_zh: 财政人口逆转

abstract: We show that the financial sector’s asset supply elasticities are sufficient statistics summarizing its macroeconomic effects for a large class of financial frictions. These elasticities are crucial for a wide range of policy questions, ranging from the size of fiscal multipliers to the relative effectiveness of asset purchases targeting the financial sector versus tax cuts targeting households. Workhorse macroeconomic models imply different values of these elasticities, generating output responses to policies that differ by orders of magnitude. We construct empirical measures of these elasticities and evaluate their policy implications in a quantitative model with household heterogeneity and illiquidity.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于一大类金融摩擦而言，金融部门的资产供给弹性是概括其宏观经济效应的充分统计量。这些弹性对于广泛的政策问题至关重要，涵盖从财政乘数的大小到针对金融部门的资产购买与针对家庭的减税政策相对有效性的比较。主流宏观经济模型对这些弹性赋予了不同的数值，导致政策对产出的影响幅度相差数个数量级。我们构建了这些弹性的实证度量指标，并在包含家庭异质性与非流动性的量化模型中评估其政策含义。
title: Financial Intermediation and Aggregate Demand: A Sufficient Statistics Approach
title_zh: 金融中介与总需求：一个充分统计量方法

abstract: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.
abstract_zh: 货币政策通过哪些渠道影响金融稳定？中央银行能否（且是否应当）通过偏离价格稳定目标来预防金融危机？货币政策本身在多大程度上可能无意中滋生金融脆弱性？我们通过构建一个包含资本积累以及信贷市场中逆向选择与道德风险所引发内生金融危机的新凯恩斯模型来回答这些问题。研究结论有三点：第一，货币政策既在短期（通过总需求渠道）也在中期（通过资本积累渠道）影响危机发生概率；第二，中央银行可通过容忍短期通胀波动率上升来降低中期危机发生率；第三，长期宽松货币政策后骤然收紧可能引发金融危机。
title: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
title_zh: 货币政策与内生金融危机

abstract: Do periods of persistently loose monetary policy increase financial fragility and the likelihood of a financial crisis? This is a central question for policymakers, yet the literature does not provide systematic empirical evidence about this link at the aggregate level. In this article, we fill this gap by analysing long-run historical data. We find that when the stance of monetary policy is accommodative over an extended period, the likelihood of financial turmoil in the medium term increases considerably. We investigate the causal pathways that lead to this result and argue that credit creation and asset price overheating are important intermediating channels.
abstract_zh: 持续宽松的货币政策时期是否会加剧金融脆弱性并增加金融危机的可能性？这是政策制定者面临的核心问题，然而现有文献并未在宏观层面提供关于这一关联的系统性实证证据。本文通过分析长期历史数据填补了这一空白。研究发现，当货币政策在较长时期内保持宽松立场时，中期内发生金融动荡的可能性显著上升。我们进一步探究了导致这一结果的因果路径，并论证信贷创造与资产价格过热是重要的中介传导渠道。
title: Loose Monetary Policy and Financial Instability
title_zh: 宽松货币政策与金融不稳定

abstract: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
abstract_zh: 2018年美国《国家生物工程食品披露标准》（NBFDS）规定，受监管食品必须披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规要求于2022年1月前完成。该政策旨在通过强制性标签，使消费者能够推断BE状态，同时结合现有的自愿性标签（如有机和非转基因标签），以减少信息不对称。本文观点认为，NBFDS当前的设计与实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们指出，若干监管特征削弱了政策所依赖的、将披露与消费者理解相联系的推断机制，包括BE食品相关定义和术语的不断演变、电子和数字披露选项、针对高度精炼产品的可检测性排除、强制性披露的豁免，以及有限的成分特异性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时给行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了审慎政策设计在实现有效透明度方面的重要性。持续评估和基于证据的改进对于提升该法律的有效性不可或缺。
title: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
title_zh: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品信息披露标准的透明度与市场影响

abstract: We investigate the impact of expectations about future climate policy on investment decisions of fossil fuel firms. Our empirical analysis reveals that within the fossil fuel industry, firms with high exposure to climate policy significantly increased their investment in response to the Paris Agreement relative to firms with low exposure. Importantly, the result is driven by traditional investment in fossil fuel exploration and extraction with no indications that firms invested in a transition towards renewable energy production, nor in reducing the carbon-intensity of fossil fuel production. Our findings contribute to the ongoing discussion about the potential adverse effects of delaying the implementation of planned climate regulation.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了关于未来气候政策预期对化石燃料企业投资决策的影响。实证分析显示，在化石燃料行业内，相较于气候政策暴露度较低的企业，暴露度高的企业在《巴黎协定》后显著增加了投资。重要的是，这一结果主要由对化石燃料勘探与开采的传统投资驱动，并未发现企业投资转向可再生能源生产或降低化石燃料生产碳强度的迹象。我们的发现为当前关于推迟实施既定气候监管可能带来的不利影响的讨论提供了参考。
title: Burn now or never? Climate policy exposure and investment of fossil fuel firms
title_zh: 现在燃烧还是永不燃烧？气候政策暴露与化石燃料企业投资

abstract: We propose a formal framework for measuring the authority of individuals in opinion dynamics. Our framework is based on an axiomatic foundation in the tradition of coalitional game theory. We show that the unique solution concept satisfying our axioms is a generalization of the “authority distribution” notion of Hu and Shapley. Our approach is based on the dynamics of opinion exchange rather than on network topology. However, for any fixed opinion dynamics, our authority concept associates a network centrality measure with any given network topology. Earlier as well as new network centrality measures are obtained in this way.
abstract_zh: 我们提出一个正式框架，用以衡量意见动态中个体的权威性。该框架建立在联盟博弈论传统的公理化基础之上。我们证明，满足我们公理的唯一解概念是胡和沙普利“权威分布”概念的推广。我们的方法基于意见交流的动态过程，而非网络拓扑结构。然而，对于任何固定的意见动态，我们的权威概念都会为任何给定的网络拓扑结构关联一个网络中心性度量。通过这种方式，既得到了早先的网络中心性度量，也获得了新的度量。
title: Authority measure for opinion dynamics
title_zh: 意见动态的权威度量

abstract: We present and conduct a novel experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game. Leveraging the multi-period feature, we investigate how participants revise their forecasts in periods when new information—such as shocks or announcements—arrives and how they form their expectations in the absence of new information. We make two key contributions. First, we develop a new method based on forecast revisions to evaluate whether participants behave in a forward-looking manner. The experimental results show that participants do react to anticipated shocks: namely, the announcements of future shocks. Second, we identify a new strategic environment effect during periods without new information; only when the game exhibits strategic complementarity do participants use extrapolation and expect continuously rising prices. This finding suggests that expectation formation is endogenous to the economic environment; and policy design should thus take this endogeneity into account.
abstract_zh: 我们设计并开展了一项关于多期选美比赛博弈的新实验。利用多期特征，我们研究了参与者在信息更新时期（如冲击或公告发布时）如何修正其预测，以及在缺乏新信息时如何形成预期。本研究有两项核心贡献：第一，我们基于预测修正开发了一种新方法，用以评估参与者是否具有前瞻性行为。实验结果表明，参与者确实会对预期冲击（即未来冲击的公告）做出反应；第二，我们发现在无新信息时期存在一种新的战略环境效应——只有当博弈呈现战略互补性时，参与者才会采用外推法并预期价格持续上涨。这一发现表明，预期形成内生于经济环境，因此政策设计应考虑这种内生性。
title: An experiment on a multi-period beauty contest game
title_zh: 多期选美竞赛博弈实验研究

abstract: This paper embeds an artificial intelligence (AI) agent, implemented using a deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, in a dynamic monetary general equilibrium environment to study adaptive expectation formation. Agents make intertemporal decisions through exploration-driven learning rather than model-consistent beliefs. A permanent increase in money growth serves as a regime-shift experiment to examine equilibrium adjustment. Simulations show that agents revise their policy functions toward, but not fully to, the rational expectations benchmark. The speed and stability of adjustment vary with the degree of exploration: higher exploration is associated with faster policy revision and inflation outcomes closer to the policy-implied rate, while lower exploration generates more persistent deviations and distinct wealth dynamics. The results highlight how expectation flexibility shapes macroeconomic adjustment following structural change.
abstract_zh: 本文将基于深度强化学习算法实现的人工智能（AI）主体嵌入动态货币一般均衡环境中，以研究适应性预期形成机制。主体通过探索驱动的学习而非模型一致性信念做出跨期决策。以货币增长率永久性上升作为制度变迁实验，考察均衡调整过程。模拟结果显示，主体会将其政策函数向理性预期基准调整，但并未完全达到该基准。调整的速度与稳定性随探索程度的不同而变化：较高的探索程度与更快的政策修正及更接近政策隐含通胀率的结果相关联，而较低的探索程度则导致更持久的偏离及显著的财富动态差异。研究结果凸显了预期灵活性如何塑造结构性变化后的宏观经济调整路径。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, Volume 189
title: Can an AI agent hit a moving target?
title_zh: AI智能体能否击中移动目标？
